home.title: The receptionist that never sleeps
home.subtitle: Answers your customers' messages instantly, in Czech and English, using only your own information. When it isn't sure, it hands over to you.

points.instant: Replies within seconds, day and night
points.honest: Never makes things up: answers only from your info
points.control: You see every conversation and can step in any time

auth.acceptPrivacy: By signing up you agree to our <link>privacy policy</link>.
auth.checkEmailBody: We sent a confirmation link to {email}. Click it to activate your account. You can open it on any device.
auth.emailConfirmed: Your email is confirmed. Please log in.
auth.forgotBody: Enter your email and we'll send you a link to choose a new password.
auth.forgotSent: If an account exists for that email, we've sent it a reset link.
auth.confirmFailedBody: The link has expired or was already used. Try logging in, or request a new link.

errors.emailNotConfirmed: Please confirm your email first. Check your inbox for the link.
errors.weakPassword: This password is too weak. Use at least 8 characters.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.invalidEmail: Please enter a valid email address.
errors.userExists: An account with this email already exists. Log in, or reset your password if you forgot it.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.samePassword: The new password must be different from the old one.

onboarding.title: Set up your receptionist
onboarding.changeLater: You can change everything later in Settings.
onboarding.doneBody: Your receptionist will only know what you filled in. The more FAQs you add, the more questions it can answer on its own.

settings.title: Settings
settings.readOnly: Only the owner of the business can change these settings.

widget.title: Chat widget for your website
widget.intro: Add the chat bubble to your website, so your receptionist can answer customers there.
widget.offHint: While it's off, the chat bubble shows that the chat is unavailable.
widget.snippetHint: Paste it into your website, just before the closing '</body>' tag. On Wix, WordPress or Webflow use "custom code" / "footer code" in the site settings. If someone else manages your website, send them this code.
widget.tryHint: Ask what your customers usually ask. Test conversations are marked so they don't count in your statistics.
widget.staffOnly: Only the owner can set up the chat widget.
widget.notReady: Finish the basics of your business profile first.
widget.appearanceIntro: The chat is deliberately neutral so it fits your website. Pick a colour that matches your logo or site.
widget.accentHint: Customer messages and buttons. We pick the text colour on it so it's always readable.
widget.appearanceSaved: Appearance saved. The preview below already uses it.
widget.appearanceFailed: Couldn't save the appearance. Please try again.

check.title: Chat check

database.ok: The server can reach the chat (the Supabase secret key works).
database.missing_key: SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY is missing in Vercel. The website chat can't work without it.
database.wrong_key: SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY in Vercel is invalid. Paste the sb_secret_… key from Supabase again (Project Settings → API Keys → Secret keys) and redeploy.
database.error: The server can't reach the chat because of an error (see below).

channel.not_found: No chat with this key in the database.
channel.disabled: The chat is switched off. Switch it on above.

ai.missing: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is missing in Vercel: the receptionist can only pass messages to the team.

check.key: Your chat key: {key} (must match the code on your website).

dashboard.finishSetupBody: A few steps are left before your receptionist knows enough to help.

checklist.services: {count, plural, =0 {No services yet} one {# service} other {# services}}
checklist.hours: {count, plural, =0 {Opening hours not set} one {Open # day a week} other {Open # days a week}}

checklist.faqsTip: Tip: aim for at least 5 FAQs.
checklist.rules: {count, plural, =0 {No "never answer" topics} one {# "never answer" topic} other {# "never answer" topics}}

dashboard.handNote: {total, plural, =0 {No conversations in the last 7 days yet} one {In 7 days the receptionist handled {handled} of # conversation} other {In 7 days the receptionist handled {handled} of # conversations}}

tiles.total: {count, plural, one {conversation in 7 days} other {conversations in 7 days}}

dashboard.chatOff: The website chat is switched off.
dashboard.chatMissing: The chat isn't on your website yet.

errors.invalid: Some fields are not filled in correctly. Please check them and try again.
errors.notOwner: Only the owner of the business can make changes.
errors.saveFailed: We couldn't save your changes. Please try again.
errors.tooManyBusinesses: This account already has the maximum number of businesses.

basics.title: About your business
basics.intro: The basics your receptionist needs to introduce your business.
basics.name: Business name
basics.languages: Languages you talk to customers in
basics.languagesHint: Your receptionist replies in the language the customer writes in.
basics.descriptionHint: What you do, what makes you special, where to find you. A few sentences is enough.
basics.descriptionPlaceholder: e.g. A cosy specialty coffee café in Vinohrady with homemade cakes and a quiet back room for laptop work.
basics.typePlaceholder: e.g. Tattoo studio, Café and bakery
basics.mainLanguageHint: The language you'll write your services and FAQs in.
basics.typeHint: Describe in your own words what you do.
basics.websiteHint: We can fill in your type of business, description and contact details from your website. You'll review everything.
basics.imported: Done! Please review what we filled in and adjust it if needed.
basics.importedContacts: We also found contact details on your website. We'll save them and you'll review them in the next step.

importErrors.invalid_url: Please enter a valid website address, e.g. mybusiness.com.
importErrors.fetch_failed: We couldn't load the website. Check the address, or fill in the details yourself.
importErrors.nothing_found: We didn't find enough information on the website. Please fill in the details yourself.
importErrors.ai_unavailable: Filling in from the website isn't working right now. Please fill in the details yourself.

knowledge.title: Knowledge from your whole website
knowledge.count: {count, plural, =0 {Not loaded yet} one {# page loaded} other {# pages loaded}}
knowledge.hint: Your receptionist also answers from the content of these pages. When you change your website, load it again.
knowledge.done: {count, plural, one {Done, # page loaded.} other {Done, # pages loaded.}}

errors.failed: We couldn't read the website. Please try again later.
errors.notOwner: Only the owner can load the website.

knowledge.toggle: The receptionist knows your whole website
knowledge.toggleHint: It can then also answer questions that aren't in your profile: services, references, blog and other content of your website.
knowledge.off: Off: the receptionist answers only from your business profile.

contact.title: Contact & booking
contact.intro: Where customers can find you and how they book.
contact.bookingUrlHint: Your receptionist shares this link when someone wants to book (Reservio, Fresha, your own page, …).

services.title: Services & prices
services.intro: List what you offer. Your receptionist will never guess a price: if a price isn't here, it says it will check with you.
services.suggestions: Common for your type of business: tap to add
services.empty: No services yet. Add your first one.
services.name: Name
services.priceHint: Leave "to" empty for a fixed price. Leave both empty if the price is on request.
services.priceNotePlaceholder: e.g. depends on size, deposit 1,000 CZK

hours.title: Opening hours
hours.intro: When you are open. Your receptionist uses this to answer "are you open now?"
hours.overnightHint: If the end time is earlier than the start, it means after midnight.
hours.exceptionsIntro: Days when you are closed or open at different times.
hours.overlap: Time ranges on the same day must not overlap.

faqs.title: Frequently asked questions
faqs.intro: The questions customers ask you most, with your answers. This is what your receptionist uses most often.
faqs.suggestions: Questions customers often ask businesses like yours: tap to add, then write your answer
faqs.question: Question

assistant.title: Tone & rules
assistant.intro: How your receptionist should sound, and what it must never answer on its own.

tones.friendlyExample: Hi there! 😊 On Saturday we're open from 9 am to 2 pm. Looking forward to seeing you!
tones.professionalExample: Hello, on Saturday we are open from 9:00 to 14:00.
tones.casualExample: Hey! Sure, we're here Saturday 9 to 2 🙌

assistant.toneNotes: Anything else about how you talk?
assistant.toneNotesPlaceholder: e.g. We're on first-name terms with customers. Sign off as "The Café Team".
assistant.neverAnswerTitle: Never answer: always hand over to me
assistant.neverAnswerIntro: Topics your receptionist must not handle. It will politely say it will check with the team and notify you.
assistant.instructionsIntro: Anything else your receptionist should always keep in mind.
assistant.instructionPlaceholder: e.g. Always mention we only accept card payments.
assistant.toneExampleQuestion: Example – a customer asks: "Are you open on Saturday?"
assistant.toneChangeLater: You can change the tone any time later in Settings.

goals.answer: Answer questions and share the booking link
goals.answerHint: For cafés, salons, studios… where customers book by themselves.
goals.meeting: Find out what the customer needs and arrange a meeting
goals.meetingHint: For agencies and custom services. The receptionist asks, offers a meeting and sends you a summary of the enquiry.

assistant.questionsTitle: What the receptionist should find out
assistant.questionsIntro: The receptionist asks about these naturally during the conversation, not all at once. You'll see a summary of the answers under Enquiries.
assistant.question: Question
assistant.questionPlaceholder: e.g. Which company is it for?

meta.description: An AI receptionist for small businesses: answers customer messages instantly, using only your own information.

widget.disclaimer: Replies are written by AI on behalf of {business}. It can make mistakes; we will confirm anything important.
widget.unavailable: The chat is not available right now.

errors.rate_limited: Too many messages. Please wait a little and try again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.disabled: The chat is switched off at the moment.

leads.title: Enquiries
leads.empty: No enquiries yet. Once a customer leaves their contact details and says what they need in the chat, you'll see a summary here.
leads.intro: Customers who left their contact details and said what they need. The receptionist wrote the summary.

inbox.title: Inbox

empty.open: No conversations yet. As soon as someone writes to you through the website chat, you'll see it here.
empty.waiting: Nothing is waiting for you. The receptionist has it covered.
empty.leads: No enquiries yet. Once a customer leaves their contact details and says what they need, you'll see a summary here.

inbox.pick: Pick a conversation from the list.

actions.failed: That didn't work. Please try again.

notes.needs_human: The receptionist handed this over to you.
notes.human_active: You're replying. The receptionist stays quiet until you hand the conversation back.
notes.closed: This conversation is closed. If the customer writes again, it reopens and the receptionist replies.

reply.label: Your reply
reply.hint: Sending takes the conversation over. The customer sees your reply in the chat while your website is open; if they've left, reach out using the contact details above.

errors.invalid: The message is empty or too long.
errors.failed: Couldn't send the reply. Please try again.

summary.title: Weekly summary
summary.intro: How the receptionist did and what customers asked about. Test conversations from settings are not counted.
summary.noMessages: No customer messages this week yet.
summary.insightsIntro: The analysis reads this week's customer messages and finds the most common topics, questions the receptionist couldn't answer, and ideas for FAQs.
summary.analysedAt: Analysed {date} from {count, plural, one {# message} other {# messages}}.
summary.ownerOnly: The owner can run the analysis.
summary.unansweredEmpty: Nothing, the receptionist could answer everything.
summary.suggestedHint: Add the answer and the receptionist will handle it next time.
summary.suggestedEmpty: No new suggestions: your FAQs cover what customers ask.

errors.ai_unavailable: The analysis isn't available right now (AI unavailable). Please try later.
errors.nothing_to_analyse: No customer messages to analyse this week.
errors.not_owner: Only the owner can run the analysis.
errors.failed: Couldn't save the analysis. Please try again.
